descriptions.notStarted: Nanuke apparently has something for everyone. He's way out there at the Whale Island. I should go see him...
descriptions.inProgress: Nanuke and his huskies greeted me with open arms. He proceeded to give me a resting chair as a way of celebrating the summer. Pretty ironic, considering he lives in perhaps the coldest place in MapleStory. Anyway, I should sit on this chair and relax for a bit...
